```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : A ⊆ B ↔ A ∩ B = A := by
  split
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      rw [Set.mem_inter_iff]
      exact And.intro hx (h hx)
    · intro x hx
      exact hx
  · intro h
    intro x
    intro hx
    rw [Set.mem_inter_iff]
    constructor
    exact hx
    exact h hx
```
